title: Personalized Basketball Glowing Light Burst Comforter with Name and Number
description:
Add a personal touch to the bedroom with this custom-designed basketball bedding set from Jeminise. Featuring a vibrant sports print, this comforter is a perfect personalized gift for basketball players, fans, and sports enthusiasts of all ages.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customize with your own Name and Number for a truly unique and personal sports bedding set.
  • Premium Material: Crafted from 100% brushed polyester fabric for a soft, comfortable, durable, and lightweight feel.
  • Superior Stitching: Features a whole-piece microfiber filling with tight, smooth, and compact stitching to prevent clumping or shifting.
  • Easy Care: Fully machine washable in cold water, quick-drying, and designed to hold onto dye to prevent fading.
  • Versatile Options: Available as a Duvet Cover or Comforter Set in multiple sizes including Twin, Full, Queen, and King.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Cotton/ Polyester
Color Basketball D12
Pattern Basketball Print
Style Customized
Theme Sports
Seasons All
Customization Name & Number (2 text inputs)
Care Instructions Machine Wash
